title: Close catalytic control under a finite disjoint-index joining family
statement: Initial indexed templates cover every original reaction, each stored pump plus its directed reverse, each pump translated by 2e_i, and original return cycles through the accepted nominal-gap channels. Join components with DISJOINT initial index sets by translating selected vertices c,b to H=c vee b and taking their union. These nonnegative translations preserve allowed catalytic copies, strong connectivity and balanced occurrences. Include every partial binary join using each initial index at most once. This family is FINITE: each join strictly increases the used index set. A missing pump index can be joined; an index already present is used inside that component, so no infinite recursive augmentation is needed. Every edge remains y_r+w->z_r+w with w>=0, and every w=0 original remains. The ENTIRE directed population graph is exactly preserved at every population, including boundaries and states outside the input class.
